meta.name: design-metadata-schema
meta.description: Design comprehensive metadata frameworks. Develops structured metadata templates and tagging systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计元数据框架与标签系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容或资产设计结构化的元数据方案
copy.tagline_en: Design metadata frameworks and tagging systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design structured metadata schemes for content or assets

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能为内容定义结构化字段、验证规则和标准映射，生成 JSON Schema、XML 或 Markdown 格式的元数据模板。
howto.when: 当用户需要为某个内容域（如 /content）设计元数据框架，或要求定义字段、验证规则、符合 Dublin Core 等标准时触发。

say.text: 为我的文章集合设计一个元数据架构，输出 JSON Schema。
say.note: 会生成字段字典、验证逻辑和标准映射。

say.text: 创建一个含自定义字段和验证规则的 Dublin Core 元数据模板。
say.note: 模板包含标准字段和业务特定字段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can design metadata schemas for content: define structured fields, validation rules, and standard mappings, and output in JSON Schema, XML, or Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user needs to design a metadata framework for a content domain (e.g., /content), or requests field definitions, validation rules, compliance with standards like Dublin Core.

say_en.text: Design a metadata schema for my article collection, output as JSON Schema.
say_en.note: Generates field dictionary, validation logic, and standard mapping.

say_en.text: Create a Dublin Core metadata template with custom fields and validation rules.
say_en.note: Template includes standard and business-specific fields.
